### Pre-commit hooks

Add the hooks to your `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file:

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from ccbr_tools.shell import shell_run
help_msg = shell_run("ccbr-hooks --help")

# get list of ccbr-hook
help_lst = help_msg.split('\n\n')
commands_idx = [idx for idx,ele in enumerate(help_lst) if ele.startswith('Commands:')][0]
commands = [cmd.split()[0] for cmd in help_lst[commands_idx].split('\n')[1:] if cmd.strip()]

# print example pre-commit-config
print("\n".join((
    "```yaml",
    " - repo: https://github.com/CCBR/Tools",
    "   rev: v0.7.0",
    "   hooks:"
)))
for cmd in commands:
    print(f"     - id: {cmd}", end = '\n')
print("```", end = '\n\n')
```

View the [reference guide on pre-commit hooks](./reference/hooks.qmd) for more information.

### Running Nextflow workflows

Use `ccbr_tools.pipeline.nextflow.run()` for local execution or SLURM driver
submission. Existing calls still preview automatically and resume by default.
Arguments are a sequence of tokens, not a shell command string: repeated options,
spaces, negative values, and quoted tool arguments retain their boundaries.

```python
from ccbr_tools.pipeline.nextflow import run

run(
    nextfile_path="/path/to/main.nf",
    cwd="analysis",
    mode="slurm",
    pipeline_name="RENEE",
    nextflow_args=["-c", "one.config", "-c", "two.config", "--threads", "4"],
    preview=False,
    wait=True,
    hpc_partition="student",
    hpc_walltime="12:00:00",
    hpc_memory="4G",
    env={"SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR": "/path/to/private-cache"},
)
```

Create the launch directory first. `cwd` does not change the caller's working
directory; resolve workflow and argument paths before calling if they are relative
to a different directory. `env` overrides cluster defaults for previews, local runs,
and SLURM scripts without modifying the parent environment. Callers remain
responsible for validating cache ownership and other application-specific policies.

`preview=False` disables the automatic preflight preview; an explicit `-preview`
always runs locally without submitting a job, even in SLURM mode. `debug=True`
prints commands and writes any submission script without launching processes.
Generic SLURM clusters are supported without a recognized cluster profile.
Module loading and cluster environment defaults apply only on recognized clusters;
use `hpc_modules=""` to disable module loading there. SLURM logs go to
`log/slurm_%j.log`.

The runner adds `-resume` unless a session is supplied (`-resume SESSION` or
`-resume=SESSION`). `force_all=True` removes either form. Profiles from repeated
`-profile` or `-profile=...` options are merged with the cluster and execution-mode
profiles. Malformed profile lists raise `ValueError`.

Preview, workflow, and submission failures raise `subprocess.CalledProcessError`.
With `wait=True`, `sbatch --wait` also reports driver job failure; without it,
successful submission does not imply workflow completion. Module and environment
setup failures stop execution instead of being hidden by a later command.
